notes: All I/O counts and grades taken verbatim from Blackmagic's own tech-specs page (ATEM SDI Extreme ISO column): 8x 3G-SDI inputs (BNC), 4x independently-assignable 3G-SDI "Total Aux Outputs" (BNC, labeled AUX in retailer/press descriptions - device supports up to 16-way multiview routable to any of these), 2x 3.5mm stereo mini-jack audio inputs, 1x 3.5mm stereo mini-jack audio output, 2x USB-C 3.1 Gen 1, 1x RJ45 (10/100/1000 BaseT), and 1x external 12V DC power supply (36W). No genlock/reference or timecode connector ("Timecode Connection: None" per spec). Desktop chassis (~370 x 151 x 40 mm per BMD specs) - no rack ears/rack ISO documented, so rackUnits omitted. Power input is modeled as dc-barrel because the unit ships with an external 12V "power brick" (confirmed by B&H/Amazon listings of the matching Blackmagic 12V/60W locking external supply used across the ATEM Extreme line) rather than an internal AC inlet; exact barrel pin/locking detail not confirmed on the specs page itself. Exact rear-panel silkscreen labels (e.g. whether inputs read "SDI 1-8" and outputs read "AUX 1-4" or "SDI OUT 1-4") were corroborated by secondary retailer/press descriptions but not directly viewed on a rear-panel photo, so port "name" values are a reasonable reconstruction rather than a verified silkscreen transcription.

ports.name: SDI 1
ports.note: 1 of 8x 3G-SDI inputs, 10-bit HD switchable, 2-channel embedded audio, re-sync + frame rate/format conversion on every input

ports.name: AUX 1
ports.note: 1 of 4x independently assignable 3G-SDI outputs (Program, Preview, Multiview, Clean Feed, SuperSource, etc.)

ports.name: Audio In 1
ports.note: 3.5mm stereo mini jack, unbalanced, mic plug-in power available

ports.name: Audio In 2
ports.note: 3.5mm stereo mini jack, unbalanced, mic plug-in power available

ports.name: USB-C 1
ports.note: USB Type-C 3.1 Gen 1; external drive recording, webcam out, software control/updates, panel connection, or RTMP streaming tether

ports.name: USB-C 2
ports.note: USB Type-C 3.1 Gen 1; second port, same functions as USB-C 1

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: 10/100/1000 BaseT; live streaming (RTMP), software control/updates, direct or networked control-panel connection

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: Powered by included 1x external 12V DC power supply (36W); device-side connector modeled as DC barrel since the PSU is an external brick, not an internal IEC inlet
